title: Tween engine: per-property ease curves (rotation/scale/color/filter) discarded
description: Flash 8 stores up to 6 ease curves per keyframe (useSingleEaseCurve + easeForPosition/rotation/scale/color/filters). timeline-query.ts only forwards the position/all curve to interpolateTween(). Fix: thread all 6 curves through TweenConfig and apply per-property curves in interpolate.ts rotation/scale/color/filter interpolation.
